items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: Yeah, I played parades with Shots.

ctx.x: About one more minute left here. About another minute left on the tape. Is there anything else you want to say before we quit? About, uh, either any of the jobs you've played. Or any of your favorite musicians. Or anything at all that you want to add to the story. I know that you have Shots Madison down there.
Yeah, well, he's one of them I put on that I played several jobs with him. Did you play parades and things too? Yeah, I played parades with Shots. Shots.
He was supposed to be pretty good, wasn't he?
